item.title: MEKA :: RE: Meka 0.80 with new sound engine *TESTERS WANTED!*
item.description:
Author: armixer24
Posted: Sun Nov 01, 2026 11:05 pm (GMT 0)

Attempting to run this build of Meka on my Mac (OS 26-ish), the app crashes upon startup. It complains that libfreetype.6.dylib is not in the expected path (/opt/local/lib/libfreetype.6.dylib).

I'm a bit nooby when it comes to libraries on Mac OS. I do have freetype installed in "homebrew" (the package manager), is there not a way to let meka look for it there ? Otherwise I'll try copy-pasting it in the expected path but I think I may end up doing this for more libraries... :P

EDIT: I added a simlink for both libfreetype and libpng from their path in homebrew to the expected paths by meka. This was a bit annoying to do, but it launches now...
